content:
Roc PDF has a new release -- I've been using it for generating manuals for my repositories and it's been great.

https://github.com/lukewilliamboswell/roc-pdf/releases/tag/0.1.0

There are still plenty of rough edges and work to do to fill out or complete the roadmap (primarily verification testing against the standards), but the core features are available and good enough to generate real documents.
